integrity: The proof gives an all-parameter step classification and explicit integral and mod-two cocycles. A standalone checker reconstructs the family and exhaustively verifies the short-cycle classification for m=4 through 20 as a corroborating finite sweep, not as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the cyclic Klein-bottle family Q_{2m+1,2} only for m>=4 and to simple simplicial edge length. It does not classify longer free-homology representatives or optimize across other Klein-bottle triangulations.
title: Torsion alone fills the four-edge systolic shell of \(Q_{2m+1,2}\) for \(m\ge4\)
